The Silverbirch Hiking Club is planning a winter hike in the Slieve Bloom mountains on Sunday 30 November.

Meet at 9am at the Glenbarrow car park. The route is 12 km, and with winter conditions on the mountain, sturdy boots are essential.

All members are welcome — come and enjoy the Slieve Bloom in the winter light.

What a remarkable autumn it has been at the Marlow Food Bank!

This past season, our dedicated volunteers worked tirelessly to pack an incredible 1,320 hampers for local families and individuals in need. Whether it was your first day volunteering or your fiftieth, we want to say a heartfelt THANK YOU. Your time, energy, and generosity made a real difference to so many people in our community.

From sorting donations to sealing boxes and loading vans, every single hour you gave helped ensure that no one in Marlow went without a safe, nutritious meal. 1,320 hampers is a truly impressive achievement, and it is all thanks to you.

Now, as we move into the festive season, we have exciting news to share:

🎄 CHRISTMAS COLLECTION 🎄

We will be holding our annual Christmas Collection on Saturday 13 December at the Market Square car park. This is a wonderful opportunity for the whole community to come together, donate goods, and spread some holiday cheer.

All donations of non-perishable food items, toiletries, and household essentials are welcome. If you would like to help out on the day, please drop us a message and we will add you to the volunteer roster.

We look forward to seeing you there — and to another season of kindness and community spirit in Marlow.

With gratitude,
The Marlow Food Bank Team

What a remarkable autumn it has been at the Marlow Food Bank. Thanks to the generous hours given by our dedicated volunteers, we packed 1,320 hampers this season — each one carefully assembled to help families and neighbours get through the colder months. Whether you were on the packing line, sorting donations, or helping with deliveries, we couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.

Now we turn our attention to Christmas. Our Christmas collection takes place on Wednesday 13 December at the Market Square car park. We're looking for non-perishable food items, toiletries, and household essentials — every donation, big or small, makes a real difference to the people we support.

If you'd like to volunteer on the day, or simply drop off a donation, come along to the Market Square car park on 13 December. We'd be delighted to see you there.

With thanks,
The Marlow Food Bank team

args.body:
**TL;DR:** Staging will be migrated over the weekend of **22–23 November**. Staging goes **read-only from 6:00 pm Friday (21 Nov)**. Plan your work accordingly.

## What's happening

Over the upcoming weekend, the staging environment will be migrated to new infrastructure. This is a planned maintenance window to keep staging in line with our production topology and to reduce the risk of environment drift.

## Timeline

- **Friday, 21 Nov – 6:00 pm:** Staging switches to **read-only** mode. You can still view logs and dashboards, but no writes, deploys, or schema changes will be accepted.
- **Saturday, 22 Nov – Sunday, 23 Nov:** Migration window. Staging will be **fully unavailable** for part of this period.
- **Monday, 24 Nov:** Staging is expected to be back online and fully writable by the start of the day. We'll confirm on the #eng-ops channel once the migration is complete.

## What you need to do

Cost is €10 for non-members (free for members). Wetsuits and all equipment are provided.

Spaces are limited, so please sign up early. Everyone is welcome, including new paddlers.

In January we fitted new ventilation units in six classrooms at Northgate School. In the spring term, pupil absence due to illness in those six classes was 3.9%, compared with 4.6% in the remaining classes.

We are sharing these figures for transparency, but we want to be clear: the six classrooms were not selected at random, and other factors (year group, cohort, timing) may differ between the groups. As our business manager has noted, it is too early to conclude that the ventilation units caused the lower absence rate. We will continue to monitor and report as more data becomes available.

Dear members,
